name: OpenCoder
abstract: OpenCoder is an open cookbook for building top-tier code language models: the complete, reproducible recipe — data pipeline, corpus, training details, and checkpoints — behind a code LLM family that matches leading models of its size. TokenWave tracks it as the transparency baseline for the Programmer career.
contributions: Releases the full production chain of a competitive code LLM: reproducible data pipeline, the RefineCode pretraining corpus, and intermediate checkpoints.
RefineCode contains roughly 2.5 trillion tokens of code-heavy data with language-specific cleaning rules.
Documents which pretraining and annealing choices actually move code capability, verified by ablation.
method: Pretraining data is cleaned with per-language heuristics and deduplication, then annealed with high-quality synthetic data.
Instruction tuning uses a large curated SFT set; every stage is released for inspection.
The paper reports standard code-benchmark results against open and closed models of comparable size.

metrics.name: Openness
metrics.note: Tracked qualitatively: the project's value is the reproducible recipe, not a single score.
